questions.question: When faced with a technical issue that impacts many users, which action should be taken first?
What do you think is the most common reason technology companies fail to solve problems quickly?
When working on a project, what is the best way to ensure that you don't overlook potential problems?
options: Delegate all risk assessments to another team
Have multiple team members review the problem
Focus only on the final outcome
questions.answer: Have multiple team members review the problem

questions.question: If you're working in a team to solve a problem and someone is resistant to a proposed solution, what should you do?
options: Ignore their concerns and move forward
Listen to their viewpoint and consider alternatives
End the discussion and choose another solution
questions.answer: Listen to their viewpoint and consider alternatives
